field_contract: Field keys are internal evidence checks, not authority form codes. Conditional fields need an explicit applicability answer; missing input means unknown, not exemption.
limits: Not a complete EU or national legal inventory and not 27 accepted filing formats.
A passed evidence check does not establish compliance, product safety, payment eligibility, certification or authority acceptance.
National/regional law, derogations, species, use types and scheme choices require confirmation. Do not compute a deadline from an unresolved national option.
A changed page is a review signal, not proof that a rule changed or entered into force.
Preserve original units, dates, identifiers and evidence. Zero, null and missing are distinct; do not invent historical activity.

rules.title: Keep a record of every professional plant-protection product use

requirements.label: Actual product use, separate from purchase evidence

fields.label: Size or amount actually treated, preserving the original unit

deadline.reason: No universally applicable national calendar deadline is established by this catalogue.

scope.assessment: Record completeness and evidence review, not legal compliance or authority acceptance.

effective.pre_existing_base_duty: Article 67 already required professional-user records before the detailed rules began applying in 2026.

limits: A receipt establishes acquisition, not application. Do not infer a dose, date, crop or treated area from a purchase.
The five-year rule for producers/suppliers is not the professional-user three-year minimum. National retention can be longer.
Product authorisation, label restrictions and national additions need separate review; completeness does not establish lawful use.

electronic_transfer.pre_2030_longer_option: Only where the Member State permits it; electronic records must be available before 31 January following the use year.
electronic_transfer.pre_2027_exemption: Only where the Member State permits no electronic conversion for uses before 2027-01-01.

authority_request.early_electronic_request: Earlier of the applicable transfer deadline or ten working days, under Article 4 conditions.

legal_timing.contractor: Give the contracting person access or a copy without undue delay or restrictions.

national_options.interpretation: EU 2025/2203 gives a Member State option, not a universal one-year postponement.

verified.pre_2030_transition: The ministry describes conversion by 31 January following the use year; check the legal order and any request-specific timing.

citations.section: Announcement of 4 November 2025; final two paragraphs

limits: Existing electronic monthly transmission for the specified agricultural holdings over 200 ha is unchanged through 2026. Do not treat the general transition as their exemption.
The area threshold concerns the listed LPIS crop categories combined, not every land-area measure.

verified.evidence: Current NRW authority guidance states machine-readable digital records from 2027; additional 2026 fields and immediate recording remain.
limits: Regional authority guidance is not treated as exhaustive verification of every Land's implementation.

national_options.other_countries: not_verified; no nationwide postponement or absence of one is inferred.

retention_addendum.text: Section 11 counts the minimum three years from the beginning of the year following record creation; do not use a simple 1095-day deletion rule.

fields.condition: Animals leave for another establishment.

fields.label: Actual movement date
fields.condition: A movement occurs.

fields.condition: Required for that species and movement.

fields.label: Mortality record
fields.condition: Deaths occur.

fields.label: Relevant biosecurity, surveillance, treatment, test and health-visit records
fields.condition: Appropriate to the species/category and applicable animal-health duties.

deadline.reason: Check the competent authority, campaign and applicable national rules; no universal filing date is established here.

limits: Scope is establishments subject to registration or approval; low-risk exemptions require a Member State decision.
An accessible, up-to-date official database may replace duplicate records only under Article 102(4) conditions.
Species-specific identification, birth/death details and movement-document exemptions require authority review; this is not a universal ear-tag validator.

rules.title: Check species-specific animal registry notifications

requirements.label: Actual events and evidence of the required registry notification

fields.label: Origin registration number
fields.condition: Relevant to a movement.

fields.label: Destination registration number
fields.condition: Relevant to a movement.

fields.label: Official notification/reference
fields.condition: The event must be notified for this species and national route.

deadline.reason: Check the competent authority, campaign and applicable national rules; no universal filing date is established here.

limits: Bovine births, deaths and movements are not the same notification set as sheep/goat/pig movements. Do not apply every event to every species.
Seven days is an EU upper bound for the ordinary national transmission period, not a verified national deadline for every event.
Birth reporting may use identification date as its national clock start. The mountain-pasture bovine movement exception may permit up to 14 days.
Animal identification has separate age/before-departure rules and derogations. Recording an animal purchase does not itself notify the registry.

legal_timing.identification: Check species-specific period and before-departure requirement; no universal calculated deadline.

National additions, product authorisation and prescribing rules remain outside this completeness check.

The downstream duty concerns other businesses; do not invent an obligation to identify every final retail consumer.
Sector-specific and national rules can add fields and retention. A purchase ledger alone does not establish complete traceability.

citations.section: Articles 1–3 and Annex adding Annex III point 2(c)
citations.version: 2026-02-10 publication; national authorisation must be established

effective.transposition_deadline_actor: Member States, not a farmer filing deadline

limits: Binding programme rules depend on designated vulnerable zones or whole-territory implementation and national measures.
The 170 kg nitrogen/ha/year figure concerns livestock manure, including animal deposition, not a universal limit on all fertiliser.
2026/288 permits national authorisation of specified processed-manure materials up to a separate additional 80 kg N/ha/year under conditions. It is not automatic permission to apply 250 kg N.
Do not infer closure periods, storage capacity, nutrient balance, derogations or record formats from this EU reference alone.
